definition_en: To succeed in reaching a particular goal or status.
example_sentence: Students work hard to achieve good marks in their exams.

definition_en: Extremely important and necessary.
example_sentence: Regular practice is essential for learning a new language.

definition_en: To grow or cause to grow and become more mature or advanced.
example_sentence: She wants to develop her speaking skills before traveling.

definition_en: Correct in all details; exact.
example_sentence: Make sure your answers are accurate before handing in the paper.

definition_en: An advantage or profit gained from something.
example_sentence: One major benefit of prep school is building self-confidence in speaking.

definition_en: To need something for a particular purpose.
example_sentence: Passing the prep exam requires continuous vocabulary study.

definition_en: Sufficiently great or important to be worthy of attention.
example_sentence: There has been a significant increase in students studying engineering.

definition_en: Set up an organization, system, or set of rules on a firm basis.
example_sentence: The researchers established a clear link between sleep and academic success.

definition_en: A result or effect, typically one that is unwelcome or unpleasant.
example_sentence: Global warming has serious consequences for agriculture.
collocation: as a consequence of / direct consequence

definition_en: Including or dealing with all or nearly all elements or aspects of something.
example_sentence: The university provides a comprehensive curriculum for prep students.

definition_en: Lessen the effectiveness, power, or ability of, especially gradually.
example_sentence: Lack of sleep can severely undermine a student's cognitive performance.

definition_en: Of considerable importance, size, or worth.
example_sentence: The candidate presented substantial evidence to support his thesis statement.

definition_en: Present, appearing, or found everywhere.
example_sentence: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern academic environments.

definition_en: Make a problem, bad situation, or negative feeling worse.
example_sentence: Procrastination will only exacerbate your exam anxiety as the deadline nears.

definition_en: An illogical or surprising lack of compatibility between two facts.
example_sentence: The committee identified a noticeable discrepancy between the experimental data and the theoretical model.

definition_en: Seeming reasonable or probable.
example_sentence: The researcher offered a plausible explanation for the sudden behavioral shift.

definition_en: Lasting for a very short time; transient.
example_sentence: Trends on social media are inherently ephemeral, while foundational principles remain timeless.

definition_en: Place or deal with close together for contrasting effect.
example_sentence: In her critical essay, she juxtaposes classical philosophical ethics with contemporary artificial intelligence dilemmas.

definition_en: Open to more than one interpretation; ambiguous.
example_sentence: The survey results were equivocal, necessitating further empirical scrutiny before drawing conclusions.

definition_en: Kept secret, especially because it would not be approved of.
example_sentence: The diplomat made surreptitious arrangements to de-escalate the geopolitical friction.
